description: Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine - Notify an amendment to the Ceiling on Price Regulations, No 06 of 2017 under the National Medicines Regulatory Act.
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, specifically amending price control regulations for medicinal products. It establishes legal/regulatory frameworks for drug pricing, compliance requirements, and penalties for violations, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not focus on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the regulatory content itself.
